_comment: Every file the Pages workflow may publish. deploy-pages.yml uploads the whole docs/ tree,
so this list is the only thing that decides what goes live outside docs/architecture-map/,
Read by graphify/verify-published-docs.ps1 (the gate the workflow runs) and by
PublishedDocsInventoryTests (the same rules, exercised with negative fixtures). One file, so
the two cannot drift: an earlier version kept the list only in the test, which meant the
deploy path never consulted it at all (R13-G01).
